Market today: Oracle's strong cloud/AI earnings are a positive signal for tech, but Adobe's mixed results show it's not a universal rally. The mood is cautiously optimistic for specific tech plays, but broader market drivers like rising energy costs could be a drag.

Your holdings: SOXL (-54.51%) and SPAL (-33.52%) are your biggest concerns. Both are leveraged ETFs, which decay and amplify losses, especially on margin. Their "SELL" status and deep losses need immediate attention.

Watch: Keep an eye on the broader market indices (SPY, QQQ) for any signs of weakness. Also, watch for further news on AI/cloud performance from other tech giants.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing your leveraged losses and respecting stops, as margin amplifies every move.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or exiting SOXL (-54.51%) given its deep loss and leveraged decay. Adjust the stop from 200 to limit further downside.
SPAL: Review SPAL (-33.52%) for a similar trim or exit. This leveraged ETF also decays and amplifies losses; its default stop at 21.38 needs a hard look.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
